Your Literature Search Should:
Form the introduction of the problem from the scientific / technological perspective
Thus far in this class, we’ve learned about finding the problem from the world/market point of view
Give an overview of “the state of the art” on the tech
Nothing is (totally) new under the sun – what are the technologies that have been used to attempt to solve this problem?
What are their advantages and disadvantages?
How is implant material “strength” tested? Is there an ASTM or ISO method? Any particular parameters? What are the equipment that are used?
How are current stents tested in terms of their efficacy for opening vessels?
